summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing for B2 Quotation Lifecycle (Phase 9). All 28 tests passed (100% success rate). Fixed one minor bug in schema (pax field default value). All critical features verified: RBAC, filters, validations, status transitions, convert logic (INV-19, INV-4), PDF generation, phone normalization, and regressions.

fixed_bugs.issue: QuotationDraftCreate.pax had default value of 1, preventing lead's pax from being used when creating quotation from lead
fixed_bugs.fix: Changed pax default from 1 to None to allow fallback to lead's pax value

passed_tests: RBAC: Driver gets 403 on all quotation endpoints
GET /api/quotations list with seed data verification
POST /api/quotations from lead with auto-items from Pricing Engine
PATCH /api/quotations/{id} on draft (notes, customer info, pax)
POST /api/quotations/{id}/convert creates booking, customer, updates lead to won
GET /api/quotations/{id}/pdf returns valid PDF with correct headers
Regression: B1 Pricing Engine still works
